Graph G finite connected CW, K nonempty anchor vertices, labels and collisions allowed, n>=r=|K|, b=E−V+1. Choose spanning tree T and anchor a; replace non-tree edges by loops at a to obtain W. Explicit edge-path maps G↔W and backtrack homotopies relative to T (therefore every anchor) give equivalence of anchored product subspaces. Cellular product chain complex on W splits integrally by the exact subset j of coordinates sitting on loop one-cells and which of b loops: loop cellular boundary is zero, leaving a copy of degree-j shift C_*(Sigma(T,K,n-j)) for each of C(n,j)b^j choices, j<=n-r. Kozlov's Stirling complexes tree theorem gives wedge^{f(r,t)} S^{t-r}, and r=1 tree case contractible; at n=r, precisely r! isolated vertex configurations. Free integral chain splitting and free tree homology prove no torsion and exact top and low Betti ranks, including loop/multi-edge and b=0 boundary. Independent arithmetic K4,b=3,r=2,n=4 gives Betti (1,12,121) as displayed; 14-case bundled checker mod2 source inspected not independently run, and could not by itself prove torsion-freeness.
